item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description:
• Auto-update support — Blink now checks for updates automatically and offers in-app install
  • New "Check for Updates..." menu item
  • One-command release pipeline via scripts/release.sh

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
• Auto-update support — Blink now checks for updates automatically and offers in-app install
  • New "Check for Updates..." menu item
  • Eye Health deep dive dashboard

item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
• Add 40 guided break exercises across 4 categories: eye, breathing, body, and fun
  • Each exercise features a polished animated visual guide
  • Settings picker to switch between guided exercises, static message, or no content

item.title: Version 2.3.0
item.description:
• Calendar-aware break scheduling: shifts breaks earlier when a meeting is about to start
  • Call detection: detects active mic, camera, and screen sharing via CoreAudio and AVCaptureDevice
  • Three break delivery modes: full overlay (normal), in-call nudge (subtle capsule for calls), full suppression (screen sharing)
  • New Integrations settings tab with call detection toggle, calendar access with per-calendar filtering, and lead time slider
  • In-call nudges count as completed breaks in eye health grade

item.title: Version 2.4.0
item.description:
• Weekly Summary Notifications — One notification per week with your top eye health insight and an actionable suggestion. Configurable day and time in Settings → Notifications.
  • Smart Insight Selection — Picks the highest-signal pattern from EyeHealthAnalyzer. Celebrates perfect weeks instead of skipping them.
  • Dashboard Deep Link — Tapping the notification opens Dashboard to the Week tab. New blink://dashboard URL scheme action.
  • Notifications Settings — New settings section with toggle, day picker, and time picker.

item.title: Version 2.5.0
item.description:
• Added timer preset suggestions — choose from Classic (20-20-20), Pomodoro, DeskTime, or Ultradian rhythms
  • Research-backed descriptions help you pick the right work/break rhythm
  • Editing durations manually auto-detects matching preset or switches to Custom

item.title: Version 2.6.0
item.description: Fix notification permissions (app now appears in System Settings > Notifications), default to gentle break style, fix settings window transparency, and normalize rhythm preset card sizing
